text: I don't have a girlfriend. But I do know a woman who'd be mad at me for saying that.
author: Mitch Hedberg

text: A kiss that is never tasted, is forever and ever wasted.
author: Billie Holiday

text: Kissing someone is pretty intimate, actually very intimate, and your heart always kind of skips a beat before you do that.
author: Keanu Reeves

text: It is an extra dividend when you like the girl you've fallen in love with.
author: Clark Gable

text: I was dating this guy, and we would spend all day text messaging each other. He thought he could tell that he liked me more because he actually spelled the word 'you,' and I just put the letter 'u.'
author: Kelly Osbourne

text: Everything I buy is vintage and smells funny. Maybe that's why I don't have a boyfriend.
author: Lucy Liu

text: Before you marry a person, you should first make them use a computer with slow Internet service to see who they really are.
author: Will Ferrell

text: Never let a fool kiss you, or a kiss fool you.
author: Joey Adams

text: In its purest form, dating is auditioning for a life partnership, and auditioning means we may or may not get the part.
author: Joy Browne

text: Dating now is a lot like going shopping when you don't have any money. Even if you find the right thing, you can't do anything about it.
author: Joshua Harris

text: You're late. You're stunning. You're forgiven.
author: Edward Lewis

text: I realize this comes at a very inopportune time, but I really have this gigantic favor to ask of you: Choose me. Marry me. Let me make you happy.
author: Michael

text: Dating is pressure and tension. What is a date, really, but a job interview that lasts all night?
author: Jerry Seinfeld

text: A girl phoned me the other day and said... 'Come on over, there's nobody home.' I went over. Nobody was home.
author: Rodney Dangerfield

text: My boyfriend eats gluten-free. Now I gotta eat all this bread that tastes like free-range Chewbacca.
author: Ali Wong

text: True love is singing karaoke 'Under Pressure' and letting the other person sing the Freddie Mercury part.
author: Mindy Kaling

text: Love is telling someone their hair extensions are showing.
author: Natasha Leggero

text: Marriage is like a tense, unfunny version of Everybody Loves Raymond, only it doesn't last 22 minutes. It lasts forever.
author: Pete

text: Did you know that the institution of marriage was created when the average person lived to the age of 30?
author: Kim

text: I fell in love the way you fall asleep: slowly, and then all at once.
author: John Green

text: When you realize you want to spend the rest of your life with somebody, you want the rest of your life to start as soon as possible.
author: Harry

text: I'm scared of walking out of this room and never feeling the rest of my whole life the way I feel when I'm with you.
author: Baby

text: I would rather share one lifetime with you than face all the ages of this world alone.
author: Arwen

text: You should be kissed and often, and by someone who knows how.
author: Rhett Butler

text: Dating is really hard because everyone puts on a front. It's really difficult to see who is who, so it is important to be yourself.
author: Brooke Burke

text: I love you. You annoy me more than I ever thought possible. But I want to spend every irritating minute with you.
author: Unknown

text: If I had a flower for every time I thought of you, I could walk through my garden forever.
author: Alfred Tennyson

text: The couples that are meant to be are the ones who go through everything that is meant to tear them apart and come out even stronger.
author: Unknown

text: Dating is where you pretend you're someone you're not to impress someone you don't know.
author: Unknown

text: I love being married. It's so great to find one special person you want to annoy for the rest of your life.
author: Rita Rudner

text: You know it's love when all you want is that person to be happy, even if you're not part of their happiness.
author: Julia Roberts

text: I love you without knowing how, or when, or from where. I love you simply, without problems or pride.
author: Pablo Neruda

text: They slipped briskly into an intimacy from which they never recovered.
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald

text: In online dating, I'm in the same category as someone who owns ferrets and has a mermaid tattoo.
author: Demetri Martin

text: Whatever our souls are made of, his and mine are the same.
author: Emily Brontë

text: I wish I had done everything on earth with you.
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald

text: Being deeply loved by someone gives you strength, while loving someone deeply gives you courage.
author: Lao Tzu

text: Modern dating: where ghosting is more common than actual commitment.
author: Unknown

text: I swear I couldn't love you more than I do right now, and yet I know I will tomorrow.
author: Leo Christopher

text: You don't marry someone you can live with, you marry the person who you cannot live without.
author: Unknown

text: The best relationships are the ones where you can be your complete, weird, unfiltered self and they still think you're the best thing ever.
author: Unknown

text: Dating someone with anxiety means understanding that sometimes we need reassurance, not because we don't trust you, but because our brain is mean to us.
author: Unknown

text: I love you begins by I, but it ends up by you.
author: Charles de Leusse

text: He's more myself than I am. Whatever our souls are made of, his and mine are the same.
author: Catherine Earnshaw

text: I don't want perfect, I want honest.
author: Unknown

text: True love is when your heart and your mind are saying the same thing.
author: Leanna L. Bartram

text: When someone else's happiness is your happiness, that is love.
author: Lana Del Rey

text: In a world full of temporary things, you are a perpetual feeling.
author: Sanober Khan

text: The best love is the kind that awakens the soul and makes us reach for more, that plants a fire in our hearts and brings peace to our minds.
author: Noah

text: Dating is collecting information about someone until you realize you don't like them.
author: Unknown

text: I'd rather have bad times with you than good times with anyone else.
author: Unknown

text: Every love story is beautiful, but ours is my favorite.
author: Unknown

text: Love is not about how many days, months, or years you've been together. Love is about how much you love each other every single day.
author: Unknown
